text:
cecilia: Quick sync on the Playground streaming UI — I mocked an iteration that reduces jitter from the live token meter and clarifies stop/regenerate affordances. Posting quick notes and looking for edge cases.

Tom: Nice. What's the core change from current?

cecilia: Three main things: 1) token meter switches to a low-refresh mode (updates every 250ms, animates only for changes >8 tokens), 2) Stop becomes a hold-to-pause gesture on touch and a single-click stop on desktop (to avoid accidental taps), 3) prompt-library inserts are queued by default if a stream is in progress, with a visible queued entry in the composer.

maya: I like the hold-to-pause idea for mobile. UX question: how do we surface that to new users? A tooltip the first time?

cecilia: Yes, onboarding tooltip once per device. Also we'll show a micro-label under the stop icon for the first three sessions: "Hold to pause on touch".

dev-rel-zoe: For prompt-library queuing: can we store multiple queued items? e.g., user queues 2 prompts while a long stream runs. How do we present that?

cecilia: Prototype supports a small FIFO stack in the composer: "Queued (2)" chip that expands into a dropdown showing titles. Each item is editable; edit happens in place and will be applied when inserted.

maya: Accessibility: Dropdown needs proper aria-expanded and keyboard traversal. Also queued items should announce changes with aria-live=polite and offer a clear all shortcut.

accessibility-team-bot: A11y reminder: color contrast for queued chip must be 4.5:1 for normal text. Also ensure focus outline is visible, and the hold-to-pause UX has an alternative keyboard action (spacebar to pause).

Tom: Token meter: low-refresh is good, but some users like exact live counts for debugging. Can we add a dev mode toggle to show per-token spikes and raw stream logs?

cecilia: Yep, toggled in dev settings "Show live token debug" — off by default. Also we'll add a small expandable debug pane below the stream for internal use.

maya: Microcopy: change "Stop" to "Pause streaming" on touch to match hold behaviour; keep "Stop response" on desktop to imply finality. Regenerate should be hidden until a response is finished.

cecilia: Agreed. Also propose an ephemeral undo action after stop: snack "Stopped response" with "Resume" for 5s. That handles accidental taps.

dev-rel-zoe: When a queued prompt is inserted, what's the timing model? Immediately after stream end, or after user presses send?

cecilia: Immediately after stream end we populate composer with queued prompt but don't auto-send. User controls send. This avoids unexpected messages and lets them tweak.

accessibility-team-bot: Keyboard shortcut suggestions: Shift+Space to pause/resume, Alt+Q to show queued list. Document in help center.

Tom: One more: token meter collapse mode — collapse to a small dot with tooltip, expand on hover/click. On narrow screens, default to collapsed.

cecilia: Good point. I'll add responsive rules: collapsed under 480px width. Also ensure tappable area meets 44px min.

maya: Edge-case: if user cancels queued prompt while stream is still running, show unobtrusive toast "Queued prompt canceled" and update screen reader.

cecilia: I'll update the figma and put the updated specs in the PR. I'll include acceptance criteria: keyboard shortcuts, aria labels, hold-to-pause guidance, queued chip patterns, debounce/threshold numbers (250ms / >8 tokens), collapsed responsive behavior, undo snackbar.

dev-rel-zoe: Thanks — I'll add a note to the prompt-library docs to call out queuing behavior and sample code for programmatic insertion.

cecilia: I'll ping when the PR is ready for a quick design/dev pass. Appreciate the feedback! :sparkles:
